title: Labelled transactions per time step
caption: Top: licit and illicit labelled transactions per time step (unknown nodes omitted). Bottom: illicit share of labelled transactions. Dashed lines mark the chronological split (train 1-34, validation 35-39, test after).

title: Test performance by model and feature set
caption: Illicit-class PR-AUC and F1 on the test steps, mean over seeds; error bars = one standard deviation (none for the single-seed random forest). The F1 threshold is chosen on validation and applied unchanged. Dashed: prevalence (PR-AUC of a random ranking). Dotted: degree-only baseline (score = node degree in the visible graph).

title: Illicit F1 per test time step
caption: Illicit F1 on each test time step with the validation-chosen threshold, mean over seeds (band = ± one standard deviation). Top: number of illicit transactions per step; F1 is undefined (gap) where a step has no illicit transaction and no alarm.

title: Test confusion matrices
caption: Confusion matrices on the test steps at the validation-chosen threshold. Cells show counts and the share of the actual class (row); shading = that share. For multi-seed models the seed with the median validation PR-AUC is shown.

title: Label homophily along edges, per phase
caption: Share of illicit neighbours for illicit and for licit transactions, on edges whose two endpoints are both labelled (read as undirected; unknown endpoints excluded). The dashed segment is the share expected without homophily; r is Newman's label assortativity (0 = random, 1 = only same-class edges). Only the training phase informs design choices; validation and test are descriptive.

title: Label assortativity per time step
caption: Top: Newman's label assortativity of the edges inside each time step, on edges with both endpoints labelled (gap = step without illicit endpoints). Bottom: number of such edges with at least one illicit endpoint, i.e. the evidence behind each value; steps with few edges give noisy r (hollow markers: fewer than 20). Dashed lines mark the chronological split; values outside the training steps are descriptive only.

title: MLP learning curves
caption: Full-batch training: one optimiser step per epoch. Top: class-weighted BCE on labelled training nodes. Bottom: validation PR-AUC used for early stopping; the marker is the best epoch, whose weights are kept. One line per seed.
